# Enchantments

## Quick Attack
- make you attack more quickly

- support mace,spears,swords,and axes

## Knockback Protection

- make you have more knockback resistance

- different from other protect enchantments,it's compatible with ANY protect enchantments

## Reach

- it makes you hands get longer!

- can be enchant on tools

## Speed

- it makes you run faster

- support boots

## Threats

- incompatible with smite , bane of arthropods and sharpness

- support spears mace axe and swords

- can make mobs slow and weak

## Wither Aspect

- can make mobs get wither

- incompatible with fire aspect
